name: Cirrus Gallery
about_text: Cirrus Gallery & Cirrus Editions Ltd. is a Los Angeles gallery, publisher, and print workshop founded by Jean Robert Milant in 1970. Originally based in Hollywood, it moved downtown to Alameda Street in 1979, helping shape the emerging Arts District, before relocating in 2015 to its current South Santa Fe Avenue space. Cirrus has long combined fine-art publishing with exhibition-making, working closely with generations of Los Angeles-based artists across painting, sculpture, installation, performance, video, and new media. Its program emphasizes original limited-edition prints produced in-house alongside gallery exhibitions, reflecting a sustained commitment to Southern California's postwar and contemporary art scenes.
